-- --------------------------------------------------------

--
-- Table structure for table `call_recordings`
--

CREATE TABLE `call_recordings` (
  `id` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `interaction_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `call_sid` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `recording_sid` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `recording_url` varchar(500) NOT NULL,
  `duration_seconds` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `transcription_text` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp()
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci;

--
-- Table structure for table `lead_assignments`
--

CREATE TABLE `lead_assignments` (
  `id` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `enquiry_no` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `from_emp_id` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `to_emp_id` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  `assigned_by` varchar(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'SYSTEM',
  `assignment_type` varchar(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'MANUAL',
  `reason` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `assigned_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp()
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci;

-- --------------------------------------------------------

--
-- Table structure for table `lead_timeline_events`
--

CREATE TABLE `lead_timeline_events` (
  `id` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `enquiry_no` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `event_type` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `actor_emp_id` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `actor_name` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `title` varchar(200) NOT NULL,
  `description` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `metadata_json` longtext CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin DEFAULT NULL CHECK (json_valid(`metadata_json`)),
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp()
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci;

--
-- Table structure for table `telecaller_daily_stats`
--

CREATE TABLE `telecaller_daily_stats` (
  `id` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `stat_date` date NOT NULL,
  `telecaller_emp_id` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  `total_calls` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `connected_calls` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

--
-- Table structure for table `user`
--

CREATE TABLE `user` (
  `SL_NO` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `USERNAME` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `PASSWORD` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `EMP_ID` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `phone_no` varchar(10) NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `USER_GROUP` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `COLLEGE` varchar(200) NOT NULL,
  `PROGRAMME` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  `COURSE` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  `DISCIPLINE` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `PHOTO` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `virtual_number_flag` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `status` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',
  `email` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `department` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `designation` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `reporting_manager` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `joining_date` date DEFAULT NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci;
